# 16 oracle → 20 candidate migration matrix

Concept coverage and migration requirements. No runtime hero replacement, stat edits or save/replay aliasing.

E = exact conceptual replacement; S = strong match; P = partial match; — = no match. Full 320 cell-specific reasons are in `oracle_mapping.json`.

| Field | Contract / value |
| --- | --- |
| exact conceptual replacement | Explicitly reviewed matching fantasy plus matching unordered branch pair; never numeric or implementation parity. |
| strong match | Direct role/mechanic-family counterpart with a documented conceptual difference. |
| partial match | At least one shared branch or explicit complementary coverage; preserves only part of the oracle need. |
| no match | No shared branch and no explicit reviewed counterpart; not suitable as direct concept mapping. |

## Compatibility rule

All 16 oracle IDs remain executable fixtures with their exact current stats, branch pairs, skill types, timings and replay history. The 20 candidate IDs are a separate production-identity namespace. A future visual binding may be many-to-one but must never merge combat identity or silently alias saves/replays. Six unmatched oracle branch pairs (Ice/Precision, Wound/Assault, Toxin/Dodge, Assault/Guardian, Power/Essence, Dodge/Healing) remain explicit combined-kit gaps. Systemic role/branch coverage is preserved across the launch roster; combined-kit equivalence is not claimed. Any later data replacement needs a versioned spec, full old/new hero comparison, malformed-ID tests, seeded outcomes and migration/replay compatibility checks.
